items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: Leonard Reed, who was a dancer, who used to be very, very close to Joe Louis, was in Dallas with his wife.

ctx.x: When did you actually go out, you know, leave home, and...

And really go far away? In 1927 Leonard Reed, who was a dancer, who used to be very, very close to Joe Louis, was in Dallas with his wife. We were naturally at the Ella B. Moore Theater. A show came to town, a traveling show in the TOBA. You know about...you know...well, the TOBA was a circuit similar to the Orpheum Time and various white routes that stars traveled. Well, they had this TOBA-Theatrical Owners' Booking Association. And I was around the theater this night. They needed... usually when guys on the…

know that he could get to Dallas in three weeks. Well, he's quitting when he gets to Dallas, that's where he wants to get. So they had lost people on the show and needed people. So Leonard Reed and his wife and myself decided to join Happy Donovan and Travis Tucker's "Get Happy" show and go from Dallas to Houston, because they had contracts and the contract called for 20 people and the man would be at the station and count heads and if you didn't have 20 people he may not pay you.
